out.rationale: The post hoc false-acceptance counts are computed from the released transcripts.
out.scope: Counts cover the 115 NO-labelled items in each of the 18 released cells; all scored outputs come from qwen2.5:7b, including the nine cells whose manifest names qwen2.5:3b. The counts are post hoc and descriptive, with no model execution or hypothesis testing.

text: For the shared 115 NO-labelled items, released 7b-labelled NONE-access debate gave 18 YES verdicts versus 6 for direct judging; other access/batch counts are in the audit. These are post hoc descriptive outcomes from released data, not held-out evidence or a theorem-derived prediction.
